title: Document
description: An immutable record of one point-in-time regulatory publication. Never edited after ingestion (ADR-0002) — an amendment is a new Document, linked back via 'supersedes'.

source_url.description: Pointer to the original file this Document was ingested from — not the content itself, so there is no field here that mutation could target.

active_chunking_generation_id.description: Which Chunking Generation is current for this Document (ADR-0004). Absent until the Document has been chunked at least once.

supersedes.description: The id of the earlier Document this one replaces, if any (ADR-0002).
